Fresh raw footprint is exact against the independent original source-local baseline, including its collinear extra vertex; projection differs by under1mm. Three true triangle vertices retain centroid[55.28363353333333,25.2176177] and directed heading2.6255014113716246, with native+X toward the west-northwest high roof/apex/mast and-X toward the outer east-southeast glass lobby. Native+Z points north-northeast. The published55.5m equilateral side governs geometry over the approximate mapped54m side; accept1m principal-triangle/1degree bearing allowance. The original reconstructed bowed outer curtain wall projects5.5m beyond its straight rear chord, and entrance canopy/apron project farther; these are declared attached exterior elements, not surveyed raw footprint matches. Neither fresh mapped entrance belongs to this tower. GroundY0 is an unsurveyed reconstructed entrance datum; shared retail/parking podium and the other tower are excluded. No footprint replacement. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.
